span.p:
Modern Web Browser (Chrome / Edge / Firefox)
- Interacts via Single Page Application (SPA)
- JWT Stored in Memory / LocalStorage
- Axios HTTP Client with Bearer Interceptor

span.p:
Vite Dev Server (http://localhost:5173)
- Hot Module Replacement (HMR)
- React 19 SPA Build (17 Components)
- Tailwind CSS 4 & Recharts Bundle

span.p:
FastAPI Application (v0.141.1)
- CORS Middleware (Allow Origin 5173)
- Pydantic v2 Request/Response Validation
- Dependency Injection Subsystem

span.p:
SQLite Database: vdr.db
- Storage Engine: SQLite 3
- Journal Mode: WAL (Write-Ahead Logging)
- SQLAlchemy 2.0.52 ORM Connection Pool
- 13 Relational Tables

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WAL Journal Files: vdr.db-wal, vdr.db-shm
- High Concurrency ACID Transactions
